report: Sixty-fourth Report of Session 2024-26, Department of Health and Social Care, Costs of clinical negligence
raw_heading: 6. PAC recommendation: Clinical negligence claims are settled on the basis of costs
corrected_heading: 6. PAC conclusion: Clinical negligence claims are settled on the basis of costs
other_raw_heading: 6. PAC recommendation: The Department should develop, within six months, proper
reason: The document prints two headings "6. PAC recommendation" in a row. The first states a finding ("Clinical negligence claims are settled on the basis of costs of care in the private sector and yet there is nothing to stop the claimant using the NHS ..."), which is the Committee's conclusion 6, in the place every other recommendation in the document has its "PAC conclusion" heading. The second ("The Department should develop, within six months, proper estimates ...") is recommendation 6. Owner's decision, 29 Oct 2026 ("go stage 3").
